faq.q: Is Little Cuba the same as Little Havana?
faq.a: Little Cuba is Rockstar's renamed version of Miami's real Little Havana neighborhood, according to multiple press outlets covering Grand Theft Auto VI.

faq.q: What does Little Cuba look like in GTA 6?
faq.a: It has appeared in trailer footage and official screenshots showing Cuban-American storefronts, street life and architecture, described as the cultural heart of inland Vice City.

faq.q: Has Rockstar published an official page for Little Cuba?
faq.a: No. Rockstar has not published a standalone Newswire post naming the district, so this entry relies on press reporting instead.

faq.q: Where is Little Cuba located in Vice City?
faq.a: The record describes it only as an inland district. Exact boundaries or its position relative to other named districts are not given beyond that.

notKnown: Whether Rockstar will publish an official Newswire naming for the district.
howWeKnow: Press outlets, including a Miami-focused guide, identified Little Cuba from trailer footage and official screenshots released around Trailer 2 on 6 May 2025. Rockstar has not named the district itself, so this record is treated as press-reported rather than officially confirmed.
